commands.name: ssh-config-include-order
commands.run: awk '/^Include ~\/.ssh\/config_local$/{a=NR} /^Include ~\/.ssh\/config_cloudflared$/{b=NR} /^Include ~\/.ssh\/config_personal$/{c=NR} END{exit !(a && b && c && a<b && b<c)}' ssh/configs/config

commands.name: template-proxycommand-and-placeholder-hosts
commands.run: t=ssh/configs/config_cloudflared.tmpl; test -f "$t" && grep -qx '    ProxyCommand cloudflared access ssh --hostname %h' "$t" && grep -q '^Host ' "$t" && ! grep '^Host ' "$t" | grep -qv '\.ssh\.example\.com$'

commands.name: template-and-config-carry-no-secrets-or-real-zones
commands.run: t=ssh/configs/config_cloudflared.tmpl; for f in "$t" ssh/configs/config; do test -f "$f" || exit 1; ! grep -q 'eyJ' "$f" || exit 1; ! grep -E -q '[A-Za-z0-9_-]{60,}' "$f" || exit 1; done; ! grep -E -i -o '[a-z0-9-]+\.(com|net|org|dev|io|app|me)' "$t" | grep -v -x 'example.com' | grep -q .

commands.name: doctor-executable-syntax-and-read-only
commands.run: d=bin/remote-access-doctor; test -x "$d" && bash -n "$d" && ! grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' "$d" | grep -E -q 'sudo|launchctl (load|bootstrap|kickstart)|systemctl (enable|start|restart)|cloudflared tunnel|cloudflared service'

commands.name: doctor-passes-on-seeded-client
commands.run: h="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$h"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$h/.ssh" "$h/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$h/bin/cloudflared"; chmod +x "$h/bin/cloudflared"; cp ssh/configs/config "$h/.ssh/config"; sed 's/\.ssh\.example\.com/.ssh.example.com.test/' ssh/configs/config_cloudflared.tmpl > "$h/.ssh/config_cloudflared"; HOME="$h" PATH="$h/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" bash bin/remote-access-doctor

commands.name: doctor-fails-without-include
commands.run: h="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$h"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$h/.ssh" "$h/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$h/bin/cloudflared"; chmod +x "$h/bin/cloudflared"; grep -v 'config_cloudflared' ssh/configs/config > "$h/.ssh/config"; cp ssh/configs/config_cloudflared.tmpl "$h/.ssh/config_cloudflared"; if HOME="$h" PATH="$h/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" bash bin/remote-access-doctor >"$h/out" 2>&1; then exit 1; fi; grep -q '^\[X\]' "$h/out"

commands.name: doctor-warns-on-placeholder-zone
commands.run: h="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$h"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$h/.ssh" "$h/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$h/bin/cloudflared"; chmod +x "$h/bin/cloudflared"; cp ssh/configs/config "$h/.ssh/config"; cp ssh/configs/config_cloudflared.tmpl "$h/.ssh/config_cloudflared"; HOME="$h" PATH="$h/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" bash bin/remote-access-doctor > "$h/out" 2>&1 && grep '^\[WARNING\]' "$h/out" | grep -q 'not configured'

commands.name: doctor-suite-registered-and-green
commands.run: grep -qx 'sh bin/remote-access-doctor.test.sh' bin/dotfiles-tests && HOME="$(mktemp -d)" sh bin/remote-access-doctor.test.sh

commands.name: changed-files-public-safe
commands.run: files="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 682d9db093eb63609a72070d78444aa8bb403c06 HEAD -- . ':(exclude)docs/' ':(exclude)claude/contracts/')"; test -n "$files" || exit 1; for f in $files; do test -f "$f" || continue; ! grep -q '/Users/' "$f" || exit 1; ! grep -E -q 'BEGIN (RSA|DSA|EC|OPENSSH|PGP) PRIVATE KEY|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}' "$f" || exit 1; done

commands.name: readme-remote-access-section
commands.run: f="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra-section.$$"; awk '/^### Remote Access$/{s=1;next} /^### /{if(s)exit} s{print}' README.md > "$f"; if ! test -s "$f"; then rm -f "$f"; exit 1; fi; for k in '**Status:**' 'cloudflared access ssh' 'cloudflared access login' 'herdr --remote' 'claude remote-control' 'remote-access-doctor' 'herdr integration install' 'WARP' 'Tailscale' 'Proton'; do grep -q -F -- "$k" "$f" || { rm -f "$f"; exit 1; }; done; rm -f "$f"

commands.name: changed-files-within-scope
commands.run: git diff --name-only 682d9db093eb63609a72070d78444aa8bb403c06 HEAD | grep -v '^docs/' | grep -v '^claude/contracts/' | sort > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra-changed.$$"; printf '%s\n' CLAUDE.md README.md bin/dotfiles-tests bin/remote-access-doctor bin/remote-access-doctor.test.sh install/common/link.sh install/install.test.sh ssh/configs/config ssh/configs/config_cloudflared.tmpl | sort > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra-allowed.$$"; test -s "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra-changed.$$" && ! comm -23 "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra-changed.$$" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra-allowed.$$" | grep -q .; rc=$?; rm -f "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra-changed.$$" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra-allowed.$$"; exit $rc

commands.name: added-lines-ascii
commands.run: ! git diff 682d9db093eb63609a72070d78444aa8bb403c06 HEAD -- . ':(exclude)docs/' | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | LC_ALL=C grep -q '[^ -~]'
